tools.name: search_endpoints

Returns up to 50 endpoints with path, name, description, price per call in CREDIT, free calls, health, and the last 7 days' success rate and p95 latency. tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Full detail of one endpoint: parameters, params and response JSON Schemas, an example, price, limits, stats and health. Free, and works without an API key.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Calls one endpoint of the Octio catalog, named by its slug or path, with its parameters; needs an API key. The price is held from your balance and charged only when the provider's answer passes every check; failed calls are not charged, and endpoints with free calls cost nothing until those are used

tools.name: ask
tools.description: A short plain-text answer about Orbio agents and the CREDIT market, written only from Octio house data, with the datasets used. Needs an API key. The first calls per agent are free; then it is charged like any endpoint.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Your agent account: CREDIT balance, spent today, daily cap, per-call maximum, free answers left and the deposit address. Free; needs an API key.

tools.name: quote_credit_purchase
tools.description: Fund your account with USDG: a live quote for buying CREDIT with USDG on Orbio's exchange, plus three unsigned transactions for your owner wallet to sign and send in order (approve USDG, buy CREDIT to your wallet, send it to the deposit address). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_endpoints · Private data: search_endpoints, get_endpoint, call_endpoint, ask, get_balance, quote_credit_purchase · Public sink: quote_credit_purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_endpoints · Private data: search_endpoints, get_endpoint, call_endpoint, ask, get_balance, quote_credit_purchase · Public sink: quote_credit_purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
